description: This file defines the API route for uploading media files (images/videos) in a FastAPI application. It handles saving uploaded files to a media directory, validating content types, optionally attaching media to a recipe, and responding with the media URL and status.

classes.name: MediaAsset
classes.description: Represents a media asset associated with recipes, including URL, media type, and optional alt text.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Represents a recipe which can have multiple media assets attached.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the system, including permissions and ownership information.

methods.name: upload_media( file: UploadFile = File(...), recipe_id: Optional[int] = None, alt_text: Optional[str] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles the uploading of a media file, validation, storage, optional attachment to a recipe, and returning the upload result.

ctags.name: upload_media
ctags.signature: ( file: UploadFile = File(...), recipe_id: Optional[int] = None, alt_text: Optional[str] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
